Cargo: Engenheiro de Segurança de Processo e Confiabilidade

Responsável pela execução do escopo de trabalho da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade, com foco na identificação, priorização e avaliação dos riscos de segurança do processo, garantindo constantemente que medidas eficazes de segurança sejam implementadas, levando a processos estáveis e capazes seguindo normas e regulação brasileira, a fim de garantir e maximizar a confiabilidade, disponibilidade, manutenção, segurança e integridade dos ativos (RAMSI), encaminhando o negócio para operações mais seguras e com melhor desempenho, bem como contribuindo para os procedimentos de Operações e atingimento de resultados estabelecidos para o negócio.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Suportar o desenvolvimento e execução dos planos de manutenção, inspeção, listas de SCE, Operation Assurance Tasks (OATS), com foco nas necessidades da Operação, bem como monitorando os planos de ações e indicadores, dentro do escopo da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade a fim de garantir o cumprimento da regulamentação setorial (ANP, IBAMA, MPT etc.) e das diretrizes da MODEC.
  • Contribuir com a Confiabilidade da Operação e sua performance, no que diz respeito ao gerenciamento de elementos críticos de segurança de processo e diretrizes da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade, monitorando resultados, executando adequadamente investigações de causa raiz, e fornecendo revisão/recomendação técnica.
  • Contribuir e suportar a disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade com soluções, lições aprendidas e conhecimento através da sugestão e controle de indicadores e novos relatórios.
  • Contribuir com a melhoria do desempenho e segurança da frota, analisando MOCs, TQs, NOIs etc., participando RCA/FMEAs etc. e fornecendo recomendações técnicas a fim de apoiar a equipe de Operação.
  • Monitorar a efetividade dos processos das barreiras segurança para manter a operação da instalação dentro do nível ALARP, monitorando e gerenciando seus indicadores e fornecendo recomendação técnica se for necessário.
  • Participar de workshops de análise de risco, estudos de segurança e revisões técnicas e gerenciar a implementação das recomendações de estudos de segurança desenvolvidas durante a fase de operação, garantindo a inclusão das recomendações de estudos de segurança no sistema de gerenciamento de rastreamento de ações de segurança e verificando a efetividade de todas as recomendações com evidências adequadas no sistema.
  • Participar de embarques periódicos das embarcações para promover valores de segurança de processos, cultura e conscientização entre as equipes de operações.
  • Contribuir para o resguardo da MODEC do descumprimento aos padrões e/ou especificações técnicas (aderência aos guias internos e aplicação das rotinas do CMMS), garantindo a realização periódica de auditorias internas de segurança de processo com o objetivo de identificar desvios de procedimentos e fornecer recomendações técnicas ou planos de ação referentes ao escopo da disciplina de Segurança de Processo & Confiabilidade.
  • Fornecer informações de segurança de processos relacionados a confiabilidade e segurança da frota, executando a atualização e revisão do Estudo de Segurança de 5 anos (por exemplo, FSA e MAH case), protocolos de estudo de segurança, e revisão e validação de relatórios de avaliação de riscos para apoiar a equipe de Operações, a fim de garantir que todos os aspectos sejam analisados. Além disso, auxiliar o líder da disciplina a monitorar, manter e conduzir a revalidação periódica do registro MAH, Bowtie e listas de SCE para a frota em operação.
  • Ser o responsável pela classificação de eventos de segurança de processos (PSE), classificando-os de acordo com a sua criticidade e avaliando medidas adicionais de controle, lições aprendidas, dentre outras.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas (ANP, clientes e outras) relacionadas a segurança de processos.

Requisitos e qualificações

UNISUAM: VOCAÇÃO PARA TRANSFORMAR

O tempo passa rápido quando se faz o que gostamos. Já são mais de 50 anos realizando sonhos, transformando realidades e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento local e a construção de um futuro melhor para quem passa por aqui.

A história da UNISUAM começou cheia de sonhos, como a vida de muitos de nossos alunos. Iniciamos com a fundação do Colégio Luso Carioca, uma escola preparatória para o Colégio Naval. Passamos a formar normalistas e chegamos ao Ensino Superior como SUAM. Fomos o primeiro Centro Universitário do Brasil (que orgulho!). Em todos esses anos, a prioridade foi uma só: os alunos em primeiro lugar. O nosso Chanceler Honorífico, Prof Arapuan Medeiros da Motta, quando entrava em uma reunião dizia uma frase emblemática, que nos guia até os dias de hoje: “Se o Assunto dessa reunião não for o aluno, pode mudar de assunto.” Então, o nosso Coruja continua sendo o grande motivo da nossa razão de existir e de continuar lutando pela educação no País. Hoje, expandindo os polos em EAD para outros Estados, continua cuidando para manter o padrão de qualidade do ensino e atendimento já tão reconhecidos e valorizados no Rio de Janeiro. Estamos prontos para compartilhar com você os próximos anos de grandes conquistas e transformações.

Candidato(a), valorizar a diversidade e a inclusão faz parte do DNA da UNISUAM e cuidamos com qualidade das relações que mantemos com todas as pessoas. Por isso, respeitamos e acolhemos como fonte de riqueza, algo que torna o ninho e o mundo mais sustentável. Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Vamos junto(a)s?!

Descrição

Aqui na UNISUAM, acreditamos que boas ideias nascem de bons relacionamentos , boas conversas e troca de experiências.

Se você sente vontade de transformar a sociedade e o mundo por meio da Educação, junte-se a nós no #TimeCoruja.

Isso significa fazer parte de uma cultura colaborativa, com respeito, integridade e comprometimento para juntos construirmos um ambiente de diversidade, inclusão e equidade .

Por isso, se você é uma pessoa com algum tipo de deficiência (PcD) e tem interesse em fazer parte dessa transformação, envie o seu currículo para o nosso Banco de Talentos.

Valorizamos a formação da multiplicidades dos times que respeitem e representem as individualidades e diferenças, seja de crenças, orientação sexual, gênero, origem ou etnia.

Competencies, Skills & Abilities

title: Consultor(a) de Technology Strategy & Advisory
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a equipe de Tech Strategy & Advisory da Accenture. Somos referência global em como tecnologia e inovação reinventam negócios e promovem mais competitividade para qualquer empresa. Nossa missão é apoiar executivos(as) de alto nível a trazer disrupção aos seus setores, aproveitando o poder da tecnologia para capturar market share.

A área de Tech Strategy combina conhecimento profundo de negócios e de domínios tecnológicos para ajudar nossos clientes a se tornarem mais competitivos, liberando valor e acelerando crescimento. Em um mundo marcado por transformações constantes, o C‑Suite precisa posicionar a tecnologia como diferencial estratégico, capaz de garantir agilidade e resiliência aos negócios. Novas arquiteturas de negócio e de tecnologia rompem com modelos tradicionais e criam a base necessária para competir e crescer nesse novo cenário.

A Accenture Tech Strategy & Advisory possibilita que líderes atuem com rapidez e confiança ao direcionar suas organizações para o futuro. Capacitamos organizações a reinventarem seus modelos de operação e crescimento, aplicando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Agentes, plataformas avançadas de dados e analytics, automação inteligente e ciber‑resiliência — sempre com agilidade, escala e impacto tangível para o negócio.

O papel

Como Consultor(a) de Technology Strategy & Advisory, você atuará diretamente nas transformações que envolvem tecnologia em nossos clientes, ajudando a definir visões ousadas e roadmaps práticos. Você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar oportunidades de valor, a estruturar business cases sólidos, a pensar a modernização de suas áreas de Digital/IT/OT e a definir modelos operacionais que integrem negócios e tecnologia.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Identificar, priorizar e estruturar oportunidades de criação de valor, por meio de análises profundas do ambiente tecnológico atual.
  • Elaborar modelos operacionais de TI (IT Operating Models), governança de TI, business cases, roadmaps de transformação e planos de modernização.
  • Participar de iniciativas ligadas a fusões & aquisições e otimização de custos/eficiência operacional.
  • Fomentar inovação: desenvolver pontos de vista sobre o uso de tecnologias emergentes (por exemplo, AI, Agentes, Cloud, IoT, Cyber Security, Analytics) para suportar transformações em escala.
  • Apoiar na comunicação executiva: apresentar recomendações, conceitos complexos e resultados de forma clara, impactante e orientada por dados.

Coordinator, Government and Host City Management

Department: Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Coordinator of Government Relations and Host City Management provides administrative, organizational, and operational support to the Manager and Head of the area, ensuring structure, information organization, and adequate preparation for institutional interactions with public authorities and government partners at the federal, state, and municipal levels.

As the focal point for organization and follow‑up, this professional supports the transformation of strategic demands into structured materials, organized agendas, and systematic follow‑up, helping the area's leadership to focus its efforts on institutional coordination, decision‑making, and diplomatic relations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Administrative, Documentary, and Information Support
    • Document management: Organize, catalog, and keep digital (and physical, when applicable) files of official letters, letters, contracts, minutes, reports, and communications related to governments and host cities up to date.
    • Flow and deadline control: Monitor the status, follow‑up, and response deadlines for official letters, requests, and internal and external demands, ensuring visibility for leadership.
    • Preparation of materials: Prepare initial drafts, structure content, and format presentations, progress reports, tables, and executive summaries, under the guidance of Management.
  2. Organization of Agendas, Meetings, and Logistics
    • Institutional agenda management: Plan and coordinate meetings, technical visits, and workshops with public stakeholders, including invitations, reservations, and prior alignments.
    • Preparation of meetings: Compile agendas, participant lists, pre-reading documents, and support materials for leadership.
    • Minutes and follow‑up: Write meeting minutes in a clear and objective manner and follow up on the implementation of agreed actions, reporting on progress and pending issues.
  3. Operational Liaison and Strategy Support
    • Operational point of contact: Act as the first point of contact with technical and administrative teams from ministries, secretariats, and city halls for operational issues and routine information exchanges.
    • Strategy support: Collect, organize, and systematize data and information to support technical notes, analyses, and institutional positions prepared by Management.
    • Contract monitoring: Update reports, spreadsheets, and instruments for monitoring the commitments set forth in the Host City Contracts, signaling risks, gaps, and critical deadlines.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, Business Administration, Communication, Law, or related areas of the Humanities and Social Sciences.

Experience

  • Proven experience in high-level administrative support, coordination, project management, executive secretarial or office management functions, preferably in institutional, governmental or corporate environments with high organizational complexity.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Office Suite (especially PowerPoint, Excel, and Word).
  • Ability to produce, review, and format documents and presentations with agility and precision.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.

Differential

  • Previous experience in large events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).
  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: Banco de Talentos [A-LAB] - FREELA
description:
Overview

Somos diversos, somos sonhadores e temos o propósito de inspirar nossa comunidade a contar histórias reais com impacto positivo. É por isso que misturamos nossas paixões com trabalho. Dessa forma, queremos conhecer novos talentos que estejam dispostos a trabalhar conosco em formato de freelas. Queremos, cada vez mais, deixar nossas equipes plurais e diversas.

Então, se você quer participar e co-criar histórias e projetos temporários conosco, queremos te conhecer! Se você é freelancer, cadastre-se no banco de talentos e analisaremos seu perfil de acordo com cada uma das oportunidades.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Áreas de atuação

  • Direção de arte

É necessário criar conceitos inovadores alinhados aos objetivos de cada marca, além de traduzir ideias criativas em narrativas visuais claras e objetivas. O diretor de arte precisa enxergar estrategicamente além do briefing, contribuindo na confecção das entregas.

Os motions precisam ter conhecimentos em After Effects e Adobe Premier, além de contribuir com referências visuais de animação e criar novas propostas, para animar as artes criadas por diretores de arte.

  • Redação

Os redatores devem ter pensamentos inovadores e uma curiosidade especial para novos formatos e plataformas. É preciso criar conceitos, roteirizar e escrever copies para peças em formatos objetivos e diferentes formatos, otimizando a comunicação de cada rede.

  • Analista de Conteúdo

Os analistas de conteúdo devem transformar estratégias em ações, ajudando a equipe de social nos briefings e ideias para redes sociais. São responsáveis por definir a volumetria ideal de cada rede, montar a grade de conteúdo de forma estratégica e buscar insights.

O estrategista é responsável por definir toda a estratégia de conteúdo de uma marca, além de desenvolver projetos criativos para as redes sociais, cuidar da qualidade do trabalho e definir o tom de voz da marca.

O time de B.I. é responsável por mapear oportunidades para as marcas na redes sociais, sejam elas tendências, comportamentos ou perfis do consumidor. É necessário ter um olhar criativo para poder transformá-lo em insights, estudos e insumos pra criação.

O produtor acompanha e gerencia todas as etapas da produção: desde a definição do cronograma até a entrega final. Ajuda a controlar a pauta dos motions e editores, faz orçamentos e contrato de terceiros.

O gerente de projetos é responsável pela liderança interna do time, organizando a pauta, fazendo o cronograma dos projetos e tendo a visão macro de quais demandas precisam ser priorizadas.

Gerir, cuidar, liderar e desenvolver pessoas do time são algumas das competências de quem realiza atendimento ao cliente. Além disso, é responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente e cuidado com o escopo de cada projeto.

Contratação PJ.

Oi, somos o A-Lab!

Um laboratório de conteúdo criativo que acredita que, nesse mundo de transformações constantes, algoritmos e inteligência artificial, existe uma coisa que não muda: a importância das boas relações.

Tudo que criamos reflete o cuidado e o interesse real que temos pelas pessoas. São essas conexões verdadeiras que impulsionam nossa habilidade de contar histórias mais autênticas, relevantes e integradas às necessidades das marcas e do público.

Exploramos linguagens, narrativas e formatos para ajudar nossos clientes a construírem comunidades engajadas. Já realizamos projetos em parceria com grandes marcas como Burger King, Uber, Faber Castell, Sorvetes Nestlé, Porto e Itaú .

Sabemos que o bem-estar no trabalho é determinante para gerar motivação diante de um mercado tão acelerado e competitivo. Por isso, temos uma cultura organizacional forte, que estimula as relações saudáveis e oferece condições para que nosso time se sinta confiante inspirado para criar.

Cultivamos um ambiente leve e prezamos por uma troca mútua de respeito e transparência. Incentivamos a colaboração e buscamos conectar as paixões individuais dos a-labers com o que fazemos no dia a dia. É isso que nos faz crescer juntos e ser um lugar de potência para quem está se desenvolvendo com a gente.

NOSSO propósito é provar para o mundo que entregas incríveis nascem de relações saudáveis. Bora colocá-las em prática juntos?

title: Implementations Accountant
description:
Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

Problems You’ll Solve

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post‑sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data

The Team You'll Work With

As an Implementations Accountant, you will join a team that supports new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating, and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem‑solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Compensation

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation range for this role is:

  • $81,000 - $85,000 in New York, New York
  • $81,000 - $85,000 in San Francisco, California
  • $72,900 - $76,500 in Seattle, Washington

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Digital Analytics - Pleno você vai somar ao time de Marketing Data que tem como objetivo garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e impulsionar decisões de marketing guiadas por insights.

No dia a dia o seu papel será dividido em quatro pilares de atuação:

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)
  • Desenvolvimento de Data Layer e Tags: Projetar, implementar e validar o dataLayer, scripts de coleta de dados e pixels de mídia no Google Tag Manager (GTM), garantindo a captura correta de eventos e interações

Análise e Extração de Dados

  • Extração e Interpretação de Dados: Utilizar SQL no BigQuery para extrair, organizar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados, identificando tendências, oportunidades de otimização e desafios de performance
  • Mensuração de KPIs: Colaborar com os times internos para entender as necessidades de métricas e KPIs (Aquisição, Ativação, Retenção, Receita), garantindo que sejam corretamente mensurados e que os relatórios reflitam a performance real do negócio

Governança e Qualidade de Dados

  • Assegurar a Qualidade: Definir, documentar e aplicar padrões de Governança de Dados, incluindo a criação e manutenção da documentação técnica (Measurement Plan / Dicionário de Métricas)
  • Auditoria e QA: Implementar rotinas de auditoria e Controle de Qualidade (QA), utilizando debuggers e ferramentas de proxy para garantir a precisão e integridade dos dados coletados e dos relatórios
  • Viabilizar AI/ML: Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos dados para construir uma base sólida, viabilizando modelos de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning de alta performance

Gestão de Projetos e Colaboração

  • Gestão Ágil: Organizar, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de tracking e projetos de dados, utilizando princípios de metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para traduzir conceitos técnicos em orientações claras para stakeholders de marketing e tecnologia
  • Perfil Colaborativo: Ser proativo(a) e atuar como um parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das equipes de Negócios e Produto, prosperando em um ambiente dinâmico

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Tecnologia, Estatística ou áreas correlacionadas
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) e forte compreensão do design da camada de dados (dataLayer)
  • Proficiência em SQL e familiaridade com data warehouses (como BigQuery) e modelagem de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear o funil de E-commerce e mensurar o ciclo de vida do cliente
  • Compreensão básica de JavaScript aplicada à implementação de rastreamento web
  • Experiência em rotinas de Controle de Qualidade (QA) e documentação técnica (Measurement Plan)
  • Conhecimento intermediário de ferramentas de Analytics para App (ex.: AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Curiosidade e entusiasmo para explorar o uso de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Machine Learning em análises
  • Colaboração e Proatividade: Possuir um perfil altamente colaborativo, atuando como parceiro estratégico das equipes de Negócios e Produto, e demonstrando proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de análise

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados e automação
  • Conhecimento básico de como funcionam modelos de Machine Learning (atribuição baseada em dados, predição de churn)
  • Experiência com Customer Data Platform (CDP) e integração de dados de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, TikTok, Google Ads) e CRM (Salesforce)
  • Conhecimento de princípios de metodologia ágil

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: DBT ESS-IM Advisor
description:
The British Government is an inclusive and diversity-friendly employer. We value difference, promote equality and challenge discrimination, enhancing our organisational capability. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of disability, race, colour, ethnicity, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, age, veteran status or other category protected by law.

Main purpose of job

The Department for Business and Trade (DBT) is responsible for promoting UK trade and investment with the rest of the world. We are the department for economic growth. We support businesses to invest, grow and export, creating jobs and opportunities across the UK.

The overseas network is a vital asset in delivering the UK’s trade and investment ambitions. Embedded within British embassies and high commissions, our trade teams—led by HM Trade Commissioners—work in close coordination with diplomatic staff to promote UK exports, attract investment, and improve market access. Through commercial diplomacy, they build strategic relationships, provide expert market insight, and support UK businesses to navigate local conditions and seize opportunities. This integrated approach ensures our efforts align with broader UK priorities, including sectoral growth, supply chain resilience and clean energy transition.

The DBT team across Latin America and the Caribbean (LATAC) is led by the HM Trade Commissioner for Latin America and the Caribbean and his team is responsible for:

  • growing the overall trade and investment relationship between the UK and LATAC markets
  • improving market access for British companies, including small and medium sized businesses (SMEs)
  • developing trade policy

Information About the Role

This Higher Executive Officer (HEO) role will be part of our regional exports and trade promotion team – which aims to connect UK businesses with international export opportunities—helping UK businesses, and the economy, to grow.

This HEO role will be an Advisor within our Export Support Service (ESS) – International Market (IM) team and the role will be based in Brazil. The ESS is designed for eligible UK businesses (particularly Small & Medium sized Enterprises – SMEs – with high export potential) to access trade expertise and knowledge on exporting to specific countries from the Department for Business and Trade’s global network of international market hubs. Businesses referred to a regional hub can expect to receive:

  • access to a wide range of sector reports, market intelligence and guides related to exporting to those markets
  • introductions to a network of private sector service providers to help businesses with issues on a commercial basis, including local accountants, legal experts and sector specialists

Our ESS‑IM team in Latin America and the Caribbean currently has 4 advisors spread out across the region, and we are now looking to recruit a fifth advisor. This role will be based in Brazil, and the incoming advisor can expect to support UK businesses looking to enter and grow into LATAC markets, with a focus in Brazil across a range of sectors.

This role will connect teams in the UK, sector specialists and colleagues across LATAC with the core aim to help UK firms win and expand their business in the region, with a particular emphasis on Brazil. The individual will be experienced, high performing and delivery focused that can hit the ground running.

Roles and responsibilities

  • Actively contribute to the day‑to‑day operations of DBT LATAC’s ESS‑IM, adopting an effective relationship management and a consultative approach to working with UK businesses.
  • Support UK companies looking to enter or expand across the region: anticipating opportunities and challenges.
  • Build and maintain pipelines of export opportunities, through developing relationships with key public and private sector stakeholders across markets in LATAC.
  • Conduct market research and maintain up‑to‑date intelligence on LATAC markets, identifying trends, opportunities and barriers to trade.
  • Foster relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including trade associations, sector experts and regional partners, to promote UK capabilities in the region.
  • Collaborate with trade and economic policy colleagues in DBT and the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) both in the UK and in our Missions to address market access barriers and unlock commercial benefits for UK exporters.
  • Champion the UK’s Small & Medium‑size Enterprises (SMEs) and support their growth and export ambitions, as set out in the UK government’s priorities.

  • Line manage 1 intern

  • Language: English (essential), Portuguese (desirable), Spanish (desirable)

Level of language required: Fluent written and spoken (CEFR C1 essential; C2 in at least one language preferable).

Essential qualifications, skills and experience

  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken)
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills
  • Proven ability to form professional relationships and build trust with a wide range of contacts from different backgrounds including at senior levels
  • More than 5 years of business and trade experience, particularly in business development: building client relationships, growing market share or developing accounts
  • Experience of account and/or project management

Desirable qualifications, skills and experience

  • A relevant degree
  • Experience using project management or CRM tools to track progress against sales or commercial targets/KPIs
  • Experience of working effectively with the public sector and/or multilateral organisations, especially governments or organisations in the Latin America and the Caribbean (LATAC) region
  • Existing network of stakeholder (private and public sector) contacts within the LATAC region
  • Previous experience of managing staff, including to implement and monitor strategic workplans
  • Fluent in Portuguese and Spanish

Required behaviours

O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa.

Se você é um fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana.

O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

We are seeking a strategic‑minded and detail‑oriented FP&A Specialist to join our Finance team and help us make smarter, faster business decisions. Reporting to the VP of Finance and Accounting, you will play a critical role in supporting the company’s financial planning, forecasting, and analysis efforts. You will partner cross‑functionally with all departments of the Company to provide insights into performance trends, support strategic initiatives, and enhance financial discipline across the business.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the trends of key performance indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as revenue, profit margin, and operating expenses.

  • Analyze publishers on an ad‑hoc basis for various purposes (e.g., business performance, profitability).

  • Support the management team and department leaders with data‑driven analysis.
  • Pair with the Business Intelligence ("BI") and Accounting teams to understand the best source of information (and the reason why) prior to performing analysis.
  • Adhere to urgent deadlines and high‑quality documentation standards.
  • Collaborate with and support the finance team’s projects on an as‑needed basis, including Accounting, BI, Treasury, and Finance Operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.
  • 3‑7 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or financial consulting—ad tech experience preferred.
  • Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with proficiency in Excel.
  • Experience with Looker or other FP&A tools preferred.
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and the principles of forecasting.
  • Comfortable handling large data sets and translating them into business insights.
  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to partner cross‑functionally.

What you can expect in return

  • Full‑Time, Salaried Position
  • The opportunity to be part of something BIG

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando‑se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem‑estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will :

Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.

Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.

Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.

Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.

Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.

Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS / CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.

Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.

Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.

Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.

Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.

Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.

Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.

Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.

Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.

Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.

Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.

Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.

Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.

Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

Execução de Experimentos: Auxiliar na configuração, lançamento e acompanhamento de testes A/B e multivariados em canais e plataformas diversas (ex: landing pages, e-mail marketing, anúncios).

description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, negotiate and administer commercial contracts, including:
    • Power purchase and sale agreements (PPAs) for the regulated (ACR) and free (ACL) markets including Balcão Brasileiro de Comercialização de Energia (BBCE)contratos padrão de compra e venda de energia elétrica
    • CCEE adhesion contracts and trading agreements
    • Non-disclosure agreements and confidentiality agreements
    • Other power marketing and trading agreements as required
  • Coordinate the review and approval process of agreements amongst Legal, Credit and Front Office teams, ensuring proper execution and compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements
  • Manage contract entry into the Contract Management system, ensuring accurate data capture and regulatory compliance reporting
  • Participate in the configuration and deployment of trade confirmation templates within our contract lifecycle management system, adapted for Brazilian power market requirements and CCEE procedures
  • Support the development and implementation of Contract Administration team procedures and standards to ensure adherence with:
    • ANEEL/CCEE regulations and guidelines
    • Industry best practices in the Brazilian power sector
  • Strictly adhere to and comply with Trafigura's policies and codes, ensuring all activities align with corporate governance standards and Brazilian legal requirements

Knowledge Skills And Abilities

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Law (Bacharelado em Direito) from a recognised Brazilian university and admission to the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB - Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil)
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken) are a MUST
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in power/electricity contract administration within an energy trading company or utility
  • Concrete understanding of energy trading activities in the Brazilian power sector, including transmission, distribution, and energy storage contracting
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of:
    • Power purchase and sale agreements (PPAs) in the Brazilian market including Balcão Brasileiro de Comercialização de Energia (BBCE)contratos padrão de compra e venda de energia elétrica
    • CCEE (Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica) regulations and procedures
    • Financial derivatives and hedging instruments for power trading
    • Grid connection agreements and transmission contracts with ONS (Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico)
    • NDAs and related power sector agreements
  • Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory framework including ANEEL regulations, free energy market (ACL - Ambiente de Contratação Livre), and/or renewable energy certificates and environmental credits is an asset
  • Knowledge in below is advantageous:
    • Financial derivatives and hedging agreements for power trading
    • Transmission and distribution connection agreements
    • Energy storage and backup power agreements
  • Additional beneficial qualifications:
    • Postgraduate specialisation (Pós-graduação) in Energy Law or related field
    • Experience with distributed generation regulations and net metering frameworks

Skills

  • detail oriented, thorough, accurate and mindful of deadlines.
  • able to work independently with limited supervision, as well as collaborate and function well in a team environment.
  • able to problem-solve, think critically, and make sound, firm recommendations
  • comfortable working in fast-paced trading environment with frequent changes in priorities and tight deadlines.

Conheça mais sobre o Instituto Infnet

O Instituto Infnet é uma instituição de ensino de alto nível e orientada ao mercado de trabalho sediada no Rio de Janeiro. É composta pela Faculdade Infnet e pela ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital). Fundado em 1994, o Instituto cresceu junto com a Internet no Brasil, acompanhando toda a sua evolução e sendo um importante pivô para sua difusão.

A Faculdade Infnet é referência em engenharias tech. Oferece cursos de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais em áreas como Engenharia e Desenvolvimento de Software, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Redes e Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de Banco de Dados, Ciência de Dados e Inteligência Artificial. Possui sede no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, próximo à estação Carioca.

A ECDD (Escola de Comunicação e Design Digital) é a faculdade dos criativos. Oferece programas de graduação e pós-graduação a distância e presenciais, todos na área de criação. Os principais campos dos cursos são Design Gráfico e Digital, Publicidade e Marketing, Design de Games, Design de Animação, Cinema e Audiovisual. A ECDD também fica sediada no Centro do Rio de Janeiro, em um charmoso prédio tombado pelo Corredor Cultural.

description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados deverão abranger toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
About Us

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es (

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.
  • At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands‑on.
  • Pre‑IPO & growing – We’re backed by leading VC funds including One Peak Partners, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and Point Nine Capital, raising a total of approx. €400m to date. Now, we’re focused on profitability and IPO preparation. It’s an exciting time to join us.
  • ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long‑term success.

We are looking for a Web Analyst to join our team and help us optimize the performance of over 25 B2B websites. As a key member for the web team, you will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, tracking key website metrics, and providing actionable insights to improve MQL generation and conversion rates. Your work will directly impact our ability to make informed decisions and improve the performance of our websites.

Key responsibilities

  • Analyze, and report on website performance, focusing on conversion rates, form submissions, and user engagement.
  • Interpret data from website tracking tools (Google Analytics, VWO, Hubspot).

  • Identify and analyze different audience segments to improve targeting and personalization.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that tracking plans are in place for all key user behaviors.
  • Collaborate with the content team to provide data‑driven insights that inform content creation and optimise engagement from key user segments.
  • 2+ years experience in web analytics, digital marketing, or CRO roles.
  • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or other web analytics platforms.
  • Ability to interpret web data, using Looker, Tableau, Superset or similar tools.
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Google Optimize, VWO, or Optimizely.
  • Experience with Hotjar, Clarity, or other user behavior tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience with Search Console or other SEO tracking tools is a plus.
  • Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment.

What to Expect from Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

  • 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Acquisition Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.
  • 2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper dive into your experience and aspirations with your future manager, who you’ll be reporting to in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.
  • 3️⃣ Case Study – a practical exercise to present to the Hiring Managers.
  • 4️⃣ Reference Check & Offer!

  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.
  • ESOP (Employee Share Ownership Plan) after 6 months with us, available from specific seniority levels, because we believe in sharing our success!

Local Perks –

Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

Career Growth –

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

A Truly Global Team –

Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility That Works for You –

Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You’re welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we develop solutions that power the industry that moves the world. Our flexible pipe systems rely on highly precise and reliable structural components.

As part of the Software and Architecture organization in Subsea Production Systems, the Senior Programmer will develop new and current software applications (in-house apps), that will directly impact the work in the departments of Subsea Production Systems.

You will be part of our newly established office in Brazil to improve our support to the production facility in Acu. The rest of the crew is situated in Brøndby, Copenhagen area, Denmark.

You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users during the entire product development process, use your problem-solving approach, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

As a Senior Programmer, you will be working with:

  • Internal stand-alone applications supporting different areas in Subsea Production Systems segment.

  • Participate in technology projects across Subsea Production Systems.

  • Contribute to increasingly working with AI-applications/integrations.
  • Close end-user collaboration.

What you need to have

  • Important: Solid experience writing C# full-time.

  • Knowledge of packaging and deploying containerized applications, preferably using Kubernetes.
  • Important: Experienced GitHub and Copilot user.

Location

Rio de Janeiro, RJ

What we are looking for

The role as a Senior Programmer is an extension of the role as Programmer, and for the experienced programmer proving consistent value creation, proactive attitude, self-driven, a fast learner and high level of the relevant competencies. You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users, release often, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

At NOV, we value the well-being, development, and long-term career growth of our employees. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer:

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team.
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organisational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry.
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project.
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Good analytical skills and problem‑solving skills.

  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset.
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
